## samb-p01-v02 — argument map

**Speaker.** Utpaladeva (siddhāntin)

**Question.** What is relation, at the opening thesis?

**Premises.**
- Dawning (unmiṣan) by his body (vapuṣā) made of relation (mayena) through being, difference, and the rest (bhāvabhedādi).
- Conquering (jayati) though one (ekaḥ api): world-self (viśvātmā), light (prakāśaḥ), supreme Lord (parameśvaraḥ).

**Inference.** Thesis stated: relation is the Lord's dawning body-form, not an accident of things.


### Open
- kha reads bhedātma (whose self is difference) for bhedādi; main text followed, variant in NOTE.
